name: Card
description: A container for one piece of content. Every card has a Cloud fill, no border, rounded corners, and the same padding and type. The approved kinds are clickable cards (text only, icon, and image and text), title on image cards, link list cards and call to action cards. Clickable cards add their hover colors in their own contract (clickable-card), and title on image cards their square image and title (title-on-image-card).
sources: az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365 (design-reviewed): 16px corners, 24px card padding, the 8px space below the title, the icon, the Cloud fill and Tinta text, and the image's 8% zoom over 250ms
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365's card designs: the six kinds of card, the link list and the call to action
The arizona.edu desktop XD mockup that az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365 implements: the image and text card's 5:3 photo
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2273 (closes #2271): 18px body text; az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2286: its 28px line height
Arizona Bootstrap 5.2: the title's 30px line height (.h5), the 16px space below a paragraph, and the header and footer padding, which follows the card padding

border.width.$description: Card border width: none, since the fill sets the card apart from the page. In a forced colors (high contrast) mode, which removes fills, draw a 1px border instead so the card keeps its edge.

border.radius.$description: Card corner radius. An image takes the card's top corners, and stays inside them when it zooms.

image.description: A photo at the top of the card, in an image and text card. Only clickable cards have images, and the image zooms in on hover and with keyboard focus, inside the card's corners. The photo fills its shape, cropped if it has to be.

aspect-ratio.width.$description: Image shape: its width, against aspect-ratio.height. The image is 5:3.

aspect-ratio.height.$description: Image shape: its height, against aspect-ratio.width. The image is 5:3.

transition.duration.$description: How long the image takes to zoom in, and back out. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion; the image still zooms.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for the image zoom: ease. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

scale.$description: How much the image grows on hover: 8% larger. Implementations use it as transform: scale().
How much the image grows while keyboard focus is on the card's link: the same as on hover.

body.description: The card's content: its icon or title, text, and links or call to action.

padding.x.$description: Space between the card's left and right edges and its content.

padding.y.$description: Space between the card's top and bottom edges (or its image) and its content.

icon.description: The icon above the title, in an icon card: an icon font glyph, or an SVG that fills with currentColor. It's decorative, so hide it from screen readers.

size.$description: Icon size: an icon font's font size, or an SVG's width and height.

margin-bottom.$description: Space between the icon and the title's line.

title.description: The card's heading. In a clickable card, it's a link that covers the whole card.

line-height.$description: Card title line height. The space below the title is measured from this line.

margin-bottom.$description: Space between the title's line and the text below it.

text.description: The card's text, below the title.

font.size.$description: Card text size: the same as body text.

line-height.$description: Card text line height: the same as body text.

margin-bottom.$description: Space below the text, before more text, a list of links or a call to action. The last thing in a card has no space below it.

link.description: A link in a list of links, in a link list card: one per line, underlined, in Proxima Nova Condensed (there's no font family value yet). The card isn't a link itself, so it has no hover colors.

gap.$description: Space between the links in a list.

action.description: A call to action below the text, in a call to action card: a button (the default size, in Red) or a row of social links. The card isn't a link itself, so it has no hover colors.

margin-top.$description: Space above a call to action, added to the space below the text: 32px between the text and the call to action.

social-link.description: A social media link in a call to action: an icon in a row of icons. Each link names its site for screen readers.

size.$description: Social icon size: an icon font's font size, or an SVG's width and height.

gap.$description: Space between social icons in a row.

header-footer.description: The optional header above the body and footer below it. Both have the same padding.

padding.x.$description: Space to the left and right of the header's and footer's content: the same as the body's, so their text lines up.

padding.y.$description: Space above and below the header's and footer's content: half the body's.
